scenes.title: *Numbers*
scenes.caption: how many people · how much money · what % changed

scenes.title: *Impact*
scenes.caption: why the mission is better because you did it

caption:
"Helped run the PT program" tells the board nothing.

The fix is almost always the same: a number and an impact. How many people, how much money, what changed, and why the mission is better for it.

{flow}'s coach checks every statement for a metric, a $ or %, a strong verb, the mission impact, and whether it fits the line. Example numbers are made up.

Send this to the person who signs your EPB.
